note: Set A correctly binds the prose facts — Young's modulus 210 GPa, base diameter 6 m, and the 38.234 m center-of-mass location — whereas Set B misbinds 80.8 GPa (the shear modulus) to Young's modulus and 0.019 m (top thickness) to top diameter, and gives a fabricated quote for the 8,500 kg/m³ density. Set B does capture the 347,460 kg integrated mass that A garbles into an invented "height 28.324 m", and A also misreads TMassDen at the base as 556.587 kg/m (actual 5590.87). Both sets write TwGJStif/TwSSStif units as N·m³ instead of N·m² and repeat several table rows, but A's remaining table extractions are consistently value- and row-correct while B's errors are property misbindings.
